Two stylesheets are required (core + dist/utility/icons/icons.min.css) because fr-icon-* lives only in the icon utility bundle. tile/default was corrected: it wrapped its anchor in fr-tile__link, which the DSFR tile template does not use (bare <a> inside fr-tile__title + fr-enlarge-link on the root). Drift discovered in card/default propagated to the 7 card variants cloned from it.

versions.notes: Drift rework 2026-09-29: 11 pre-1.15 tiles corrected against the current DSFR templates — card/default and the 6 card variants (fr-card__media/fr-responsive-img-wrapper/fr-card__link are gone; v1.15 uses fr-enlarge-link on the root with a bare link in fr-card__title), card/horizontal-media (fr-card__header > fr-card__img > fr-responsive-img), summary/default (bare <ol>; fr-summary__list does not exist), button/disabled (the disabled attribute, not a modifier). Reworked tiles are canon and relabeled origin: design-system. download/default NOT reworked: the DSFR download component is deprecated upstream, so it stays a live-site observation, unstamped, pending a decision to retire the family. 60/61 tiles verified.
